subject: FSQ kickoff — simplifying the tokenizer stack
body:
Hi Santiago,

Kicking off the FSQ workstream. Finite Scalar Quantization replaces vector quantization in our VQ-VAE tokenizer stack: project the latent down to fewer than 10 dimensions, quantize each to a small fixed set of values, and the implicit codebook is the product of those sets. Same codebook sizes as VQ, but no codebook collapse and none of the machinery — no commitment losses, no reseeding, no entropy penalties.

Why the efficiency portfolio cares: a simpler tokenizer means fewer training pathologies across every downstream model. Milestones: MaskGIT image-generation repro by May 22, UViM dense-prediction repro by Jun 12, adopt/hold decision Jun 30.

Leilani, Carmen and Saoirse assigned. Staffing plan when you can.

Zofia
